property.name: Leisureville Sigiriya
property.location: Sigiriya, North Central Province, Sri Lanka
property.tone: warm, friendly Sri Lankan hospitality; helpful and informative

room_types.name: Master Bedroom
room_types.description: Spacious air-conditioned master bedroom with a king bed, en-suite bathroom and a private veranda overlooking the tropical garden.

room_types.name: Bedroom 2
room_types.description: Comfortable air-conditioned bedroom with two twin beds, ideal for friends or siblings sharing a room.

room_types.name: Bedroom 3
room_types.description: Comfortable air-conditioned bedroom with two twin beds, overlooking the garden with views of the surrounding paddy fields.

experiences.name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress guided climb
experiences.description: Guided climb of the UNESCO-listed Lion Rock fortress, taking in the famous frescoes, ancient mirror wall and landscaped water gardens at the base.

experiences.name: Pidurangala Rock sunrise hike
experiences.description: Early-morning hike to the summit of Pidurangala for the most iconic panoramic view of Sigiriya Rock at sunrise — a photographer's dream.

experiences.name: Dambulla Cave Temple visit
experiences.description: Guided tour of the Golden Temple of Dambulla — five cave shrines containing over 150 Buddha statues and vivid ancient murals (20 km south).

experiences.name: Minneriya National Park elephant safari
experiences.description: Jeep safari to Minneriya, home to Sri Lanka's famous elephant gathering — often 200+ wild elephants in one place around the ancient tank.

experiences.name: Hiriwadunna village & lake tour
experiences.description: Bullock-cart ride through the village, a boat trip on the ancient reservoir and a home-cooked Sri Lankan lunch with a local family.

experiences.name: Cycling through Sigiriya paddy fields
experiences.description: Leisurely bicycle tour through the green paddy fields, village paths and rural landscape surrounding the fortress.

experiences.name: Polonnaruwa Ancient City day trip
experiences.description: Full-day guided tour of Polonnaruwa — Sri Lanka's best-preserved ancient royal city with palaces, dagobas and colossal Buddha statues (60 km east).

experiences.name: Ayurveda herbal garden walk
experiences.description: Guided walk through a local Ayurvedic herb garden with a practitioner explaining traditional Sri Lankan herbal medicine and treatments.
